latest_release.name: v6.06
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: Environment variables by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2180
* build: Update QEMU base image to v7.49 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2181
* feat: Support GPU acceleration via Helios by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2183
* build: Copy udfread binary from Docker image by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2184
* fix: Exclude bundled QEMU binary from base image by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2185
* feat: Reduce XP and 2003 recovery menu timeout by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2187
* chore(deps): update hadolint/hadolint-action action to v3.5.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2188
* fix: Seed per-user defaults before first logon by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2189
* feat: Install SVGA drivers on 2000/XP/2003 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2190
* docs: Environment variables by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2191
* fix: Set defaults for NT5 animations by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2193
* feat: Default to SVGA device for Windows 95/98/ME by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2194
* fix: Make Win9x ScanDisk repairs fully unattended by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2195
* docs: Support QEMU Guest Agent by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2197
* fix: Pixel depth on Windows 2003 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2199
* build: Update VirtIO drivers to v1.9.61 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2204
* build: Update VirtIO drivers to v1.9.61 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2205
* build: Update QEMU base image to v7.50 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2208
* feat: Improve Helios (GPU acceleration) support by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2210
* feat: Disable Autoplay on Windows Vista and 7 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2211
* fix: Codespaces disk size limit by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2214
* fix: Resolve merge conflict by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2222
* feat: Install VMWare driver during unattended setup by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2221
* build: Install dxvk-native package by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2223
* fix: Do not install VirtIO GPU driver on Windows 8 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2231
* build: Pin qemu-windows version by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2238
* fix: Win9x preparation hangs on lowercase cabinet names by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2239
* fix: Display driver path on Windows 2003 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2240
* fix: Add additional download mirror by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2241
* build: Update buildkit to v0.25.2 by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2242
* fix: Use standard VGA adapter for legacy Windows by @kroese in https://github.com/dockur/windows/pull/2243


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dockur/windows/compare/v6.05...v6.06
